title: idev approval record
description: The signed record of one human decision. Separate from the gate because this is the part that has to stand up on its own: an auditor with this record, the server public key and the manifest can verify the signature offline, without the service that produced it.

subject_digest.description: What was actually signed. Recomputed at every later check; a mismatch is baseline-drift.

kind.description: Always human. The field exists so the constraint is visible in the record rather than only in the code that wrote it.

assurance_downgraded.description: True when a high requirement was met at low under the transition switch. Recorded so the window is auditable after it closes.

quote.description: What the person actually wrote, kept verbatim. The parse result is not a substitute: a dispute is about the words.

credential.description: The authenticator that signed, when assurance is high. Its public key lets the device signature be checked offline too.

signature.description: Server ed25519 over the JCS form of the payload, so the record cannot be edited in the database without detection.

allOf.description: A high-assurance approval has to say which authenticator produced it.
